notes.title: 📢Controls Info for Redroppers
notes.content:
[h1][b]Hey ReDroppers! Having fun (aka suffering)?[/b][/h1][p]
Just a quick note about the controls in [i]Redrop[/i].[/p][p]The game currently shows only the [b]base controls[/b], and [b]there is no control remapping feature[/b] at the moment. However, there are [b]many additional buttons that work[/b], both on keyboard and controller, even if they're not shown on screen![/p][p]Here’s a list of [b]extra keyboard controls[/b] you can use:

🎮 [b]Movement[/b]
A / D
Left / Right Arrow
Numpad 4 / Numpad 6[/p][p][/p][p]🔄 [b]Redrop (Restart)[/b]
R
Page Down
T
Right Mouse Button[/p][p][/p][p]🦘 [b]Jump[/b]
Spacebar
Up Arrow
Down Arrow
Numpad 8[/p][p][/p][p]⏸ [b]Pause[/b]
Escape[/p][p][/p][p]✅ [b]Confirm / Interact[/b]
E
Enter
Left Mouse Button[/p][p][/p][p]🏃 [b]Run[/b]
Left Shift
Right Shift[/p][p][/p][p]We will not show controller being pretty straight forward.

[/p][p]💬 [b]We want your feedback![/b]
If you have ideas for [b]alternative buttons[/b] that would make the game more comfortable for you, feel free to [b]comment on this post[/b] or email us at [/p][p][url="https://redropgame@gmail.com"]redropgame@gmail.com[/url][/p][p]we’d love to add more options based on what works best for players![/p][p]Thanks for playing![/p]
